# Niaz Mahmud Minhaz

> SEO Consultant in Bangladesh helping businesses improve Technical SEO, Local SEO and AI search visibility. Focused on Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Local SEO, Off-Page SEO, SEO audits, AEO and GEO, built around evidence and measurable decisions.

## Topic map

The site covers connected topic clusters around technical SEO, on-page and content SEO, local search, authority and evidence, AI search, and e-commerce/platform SEO. Supporting pages should be used together as a coherent research path rather than as isolated keyword targets.
